Harvard's cap on As will fail like Princeton's. Grade inflation isn't a willpower problem; it's a coordination problem no college can solve alone. Accreditors, which set standards across hundreds of schools at once, are one of the only ones who can reverse it, says Cato’s Andrew Gillen.
